title: Earth Evolution Simulator
description: A scenario-driven simulation game modeling planetary ecology and evolutionary tradeoffs through stateful decision branching.
longDescription: Earth Evolution Simulator is a scenario-driven engine where players guide a planet through distinct evolutionary eras. A Python Flask backend maintains session state across path-dependent decision trees and random events, while SQLite logs extinction parameters and run history.
description_business: An interactive simulation platform modeling complex ecological tradeoffs, dynamic events, and strategic decision-making.
longDescription_business: Earth Evolution Simulator turns planetary ecology and resource management into an interactive simulation experience. Designed to model long-term consequences and stateful tradeoffs, it uses dynamic event triggers and telemetry logging to engage users in complex decision-making scenarios.
architectureHighlights: Stateful Flask backend tracking planetary ecology variables and decision tree branches in session
SQLite persistence logging run parameters, historical extinction events, and timeline telemetry
Custom Jinja2 dynamic UI rendering event triggers and resource allocation sliders

challenges.challenge: Preventing state explosion across multiple branching decision paths
challenges.solution: Designed a dynamic event dispatcher that evaluates planetary state variables against threshold triggers instead of static hardcoded state trees.

title: ISS Live Location Tracker
description: Real-time satellite telemetry service tracking ISS orbital position with reverse geocoding and offline spatial KD-tree lookups.
longDescription: Built on FastAPI, this telemetry application polls public ISS orbit APIs using async HTTP connection pooling. Over land, it resolves reverse-geocoded coordinates via Geopy and Nominatim. Over open oceans, it falls back to an in-memory SciPy KD-tree spatial index of world land centroids, serving background imagery via cached NASA API feeds.
description_business: A real-time satellite tracking utility that translates raw orbital telemetry into geographic location insights.
longDescription_business: The ISS Live Location Tracker translates raw satellite telemetry into human-readable geographic location context. It pairs real-time reverse geocoding over land with an in-memory spatial lookup index over open oceans, utilizing NASA image caching for high availability and instant page responsiveness.
architectureHighlights: FastAPI micro-backend polling public ISS telemetry APIs with async HTTP connection pooling
Geopy & Nominatim reverse geocoding engine translating lat/lng coordinates to landmass names
Offline KD-tree spatial fallback database resolving nearest landmass when station orbits over oceans

challenges.challenge: Gracefully handling reverse geocoding API rate limits and ocean overflights
challenges.solution: Implemented an in-memory KD-tree spatial index containing world land centroids for instant offline lookup when reverse geocoding fails.

title: MetaWipe
description: A privacy-first mobile app that strips EXIF metadata from images on-device using isolated Dart background workers.
longDescription: MetaWipe removes sensitive EXIF metadata from images locally by decoding selected files in background Dart isolates and rebuilding them into fresh JPEG or PNG containers. The application operates 100% offline without network permissions, keeping private location data on-device.
description_business: A privacy-focused mobile utility that strips sensitive location and device metadata from photos before public sharing.
longDescription_business: MetaWipe protects user privacy and organizational security by stripping hidden EXIF metadata—including GPS coordinates, timestamp history, and camera serial numbers—from photos before sharing. By decoding and rebuilding images directly on-device, it guarantees sensitive location data never leaves the user's phone.
architectureHighlights: Flutter cross-platform app processing image byte arrays in isolated background Dart workers
Custom EXIF parsing engine stripping GPS, camera metadata, and hidden tags before image container rebuild
100% offline security boundary requiring zero network permissions

challenges.challenge: Main thread UI stuttering during high-resolution image decoding and re-encoding
challenges.solution: Offloaded raw pixel decoding and EXIF container reconstruction to background Dart isolates using thread-safe transfer channels.

title: PaintMix AI
description: A computer-vision mobile assistant that samples camera color inputs and computes paint mix ratios via CIELAB Delta E distance algorithms.
longDescription: PaintMix AI uses a device camera to sample target colors and calculate mixing proportions from inventory. It converts RGB camera frame buffers into XYZ and CIELAB (L*a*b*) color spaces, executing CIDE2000 Delta E distance algorithms to compute matching ratios against a local Drift/SQLite paint database.
description_business: A camera-driven color matching assistant that calculates exact paint mixing proportions to eliminate inventory waste.
longDescription_business: PaintMix AI enables painters, designers, and maintenance teams to sample target colors with a smartphone camera and receive instant, accurate paint mixing recipes based on available stock. By calculating exact color ratios on-device, it eliminates guesswork, reduces costly paint inventory waste, and works 100% offline on job sites.
architectureHighlights: Flutter & Riverpod app utilizing device camera frame buffers for real-time color sampling
Color space converter transforming RGB sampling inputs into CIELAB (L*a*b*) color space
Delta E (CIDE2000) distance matching engine comparing sampled targets against stored paint inventory in Drift/SQLite

challenges.challenge: Varying ambient lighting conditions causing inaccurate camera color sampling
challenges.solution: Added a normalized white-balance calibration target prompt and CIELAB Delta E color difference algorithm to compute exact paint ratios.

keyDeliverables: CIELAB Delta E color matching engine

title: PrateeqSync AI: Intelligent Portfolio & Resume Automation Engine
description: A local Streamlit CMS for portfolio administration, database schema synchronization, and Gemini-powered repository scanning.
longDescription: PrateeqSync AI is a Streamlit content management system for portfolio data, certificates, and technical blog posts. It syncs Supabase PostgreSQL tables with local JSON fallbacks, leveraging Google Gemini 3.6 Flash for repository code scanning, OCR, and automated git workflow staging.
description_business: An automated portfolio content manager that synchronizes multi-channel resume copy and credentials with zero downtime.
longDescription_business: PrateeqSync AI automates portfolio administration and resume synchronization. Built with Streamlit, Supabase, and Google Gemini AI, it parses repository history, validates data schema fallbacks, and automates content publishing across web endpoints—saving hours of manual site maintenance while guaranteeing 100% data uptime.
architectureHighlights: Streamlit local CMS dashboard managing Supabase PostgreSQL content tables and local JSON fallbacks
Google Gemini 3.6 Flash integration scanning local repositories and generating domain resume bullets
Git automation layer staging, committing, and pushing asset updates directly to GitHub

challenges.challenge: Ensuring database schema changes and local JSON fallback files stay 100% synchronized
challenges.solution: Built atomic JSON transaction writers and validation routines (`sync_validation.py`) that verify payloads before DB writes.

title: Retriever AI (RAG Engine & SaaS Studio)
description: Enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform featuring Hexagonal Architecture, pgvector hybrid search, local Ollama embeddings, RLM reasoning, and semantic response caching.
longDescription: Retriever AI is a production-grade RAG platform built using strict Hexagonal Architecture boundaries. It ingests multi-format documents (PDF, Markdown, text, OpenAPI), executing dense vector embeddings via local Ollama instances (nomic-embed-text) and sparse BM25 keyword indexing in pgvector. Features multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS isolation, streaming response synthesis with RLM (Recursive Language Modeling) reasoning loops, automated query rewriting, presigned citation downloads, and sub-100ms semantic response caching (⚡ Cached).
description_business: An enterprise document intelligence platform enabling teams to transform static documents into interactive, citation-backed AI assistants with zero data leakage.
longDescription_business: Retriever AI enables organizations to turn static documents into secure, interactive knowledge assistants. Teams upload PDFs or operational documentation and ask complex natural-language questions, receiving streaming answers backed by verifiable source citations, granular multi-tenant isolation, real-time feedback loops, and semantic query caching for sub-100ms response times.
architectureHighlights: Strict Hexagonal Architecture decoupling domain core entities from FastAPI routers, pgvector storage adapters, and external LLM APIs
Hybrid Retrieval Pipeline combining dense Ollama embeddings (nomic-embed-text) and sparse BM25 keyword matching with score threshold re-ranking
Multi-tenant PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) isolation with encrypted tenant API keys, presigned citation downloads, and sub-100ms semantic response caching

challenges.challenge: High query latency, API rate-limit bottlenecks, and hallucinations across multi-document contextual searches
challenges.solution: Implemented an in-memory semantic response cache with automatic query rewriting, RLM (Recursive Language Model) context verification, and strict citation grounding in prompt templates.

challenges.challenge: Preventing cross-tenant data leakage while allowing flexible external LLM key usage
challenges.solution: Enforced strict tenant-scoped DB schema isolation combined with local-only embedding generation to prevent sensitive client data from hitting third-party API quotas.
